name: 3D Gaussian Splatting Training
definition: A GPU-accelerated training loop for 3D Gaussian Splatting that manages camera sampling, downscaling schedules, densification thresholds, and metric evaluation, implemented in C++ with Metal backend and exposed via Python bindings.
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting Training optimizes explicit 3D Gaussian primitives via differentiable rasterization, enabling extremely fast training and rendering compared to implicit neural fields.
